# Descriptor-only interface super calls

Unmodified Java 8 compiler output contains a named static member class with a
conditional allocation and a direct nested-interface default call. The default
and caller have closed nominal descriptors and no Signature attributes.
Frozen observers cover five call routes, nulls, result snapshots, partially
published constructors, runtime/error identity and mutations around the default
call. Source/SDK profiles compile all generated Java and preserve complete
metadata and Exceptions inventories. Independent wrong programs challenge
lexical dispatch, evaluation order, identities and effects.
